transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Greetings, Thunderer! Brokkr and the master smiths are away, deep in the mines, and won't return for several weeks. I'm but an apprentice, though I'll do my best to assist you with whatever you might need from the forge. What brings you to our humble workshop today, Thor?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I have come to see what you have created for me, Nidafellir. I have heard much of your craftsmanship, and I am eager to see the war-hammer that you have forged. But I find it lacking something important. The balance is off, and the runes of binding are misspelled. I need this weapon to be reforged.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I hear your concern, mighty Thor, but I must tell you that all commissions from the Sons of Ivaldi and Brokkr’s workshop are considered fulfilled upon delivery to Asgard. The craftsmanship has been approved as per our traditional agreement, and even a god must wait until the next forging-season and pay anew for any alterations or new commissions. Would you not consider testing the hammer further or perhaps discussing any concerns with the master smiths upon their return?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You have failed to grasp the severity of the situation, Nidafellir. This hammer is not just any ordinary weapon. It is Mjölnir, the mighty hammer of Thor, and its power must not be underestimated. I demand that you reforge it immediately, correcting the平衡 and the spelling of the runes. Time is of the essence, and I will not wait for the next forging season. Do not waste my time with excuses and delays.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand the urgency, Thunderer, but my hands are tied, as it were. The forge is under strict order; only the master smiths may undertake such significant tasks. I'm not skilled enough to work on a piece as revered as Mjölnir. Perhaps your concerns with the balance and runes could be discussed with Brokkr himself once he returns. Until then, I fear my ability to assist you is limited. If there's anything within my apprentice skills I can help with, please let me know.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, Nidafellir. Your lack of autonomy in this matter is understandable. However, I will not let this setback deter me. I will seek the counsel of Brokkr myself when he returns. In the meantime, if there are any tasks or concerns regarding the forging process, I trust you to inform him promptly. Thank you for your understanding, Nidafellir. We shall continue this discussion once Brokkr is available.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I appreciate your understanding, Thunderer, and will ensure to pass your concerns directly to Brokkr upon his return. If there's anything else you need while you await his counsel, don't hesitate to call on me. May your strength be ever mighty, Thor, and may your journeys be safe until we meet again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Nidafellir. Your assistance is appreciated. May the gods grant us both strength and wisdom in our respective endeavors. May the forging season bring us back together, and may Mjölnir be restored to its former glory. Until then, farewell. On my way now to discuss this matter with Brokkr. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thunderer. May the anvil and hammer favor you in all your pursuits, and may our next meeting bring resolution and strength to your hands. Safe travels, Thor, until the forge glows again with your presence.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The road ahead may be treacherous, Nidafellir, but I shall make the most of it. Thank you for your part in this endeavor. Until we meet again, farewell. On my way now.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, mighty Thor. May the path be clear and the storms be kind to you. Until we meet again, may the forge's fire light your way. Safe travels!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The journey is mine, Nidafellir, and I shall face it with courage and determination. Farewell. On my way now.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thor. Strength and valor guide you on your journey. Until our next meeting, may the blessings of the forge be with you.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The same to you, Nidafellir. May the hammer's power never waver in my hands. Farewell. On my way now.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thor. May Mjölnir always strike true and your heart never falter. Safe travels until we meet again!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Nidafellir. Your words mean more than you know. Farewell. On my way now.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thunderer. May the echoes of the forge accompany you. Until next time!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Nidafellir. The forging season brings new opportunities, and I look forward to our next encounter. Until then, may the hammer's power remain unchanged. Farewell. On my way now.
